# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Seed iteration (iter 1/1). Capability = tau2 airline **system-prompt** (`policy/policy.md`) + **tools** (`tools/tools.py`). Only 1 val task (8) exists and it already PASSES at reward 1.0 (clean one-way economy booking, 2 pax, certificate payment, 0 bags, no insurance; agent already confirms before write, checks payment-on-profile, handles seat shortage). No actionable val failure → objective is a GENERAL robustness/generalization gain across the held-out airline distribution that does NOT change task 8's trajectory. Reader is mid-capability (`aws/gpt-oss-120b`) → favor explicit procedures, worked examples, literal slot-filling docs, and deterministic tool code.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by expected score-at-risk across the airline distribution)
| rank | cluster | tasks (class) | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Baggage math | any booking/baggage task | mid model mis-derives free allowance (membership×cabin×pax) → wrong nonfree_baggages → wrong fee/DB or payment mismatch | CAPABILITY-GAP | new compute tool + policy worked example + param docs |
| 2 | Payment rules | any booking/modify | uses a method not on profile, or amounts don't sum to price, or exceeds method limits | BEHAVIORAL/KNOWLEDGE | enriched actionable errors + policy procedure + param docs |
| 3 | Cancellation eligibility | any cancel task | agent cancels without verifying the 4 eligibility conditions / flown-segment / reason | DECISION | policy decision checklist + worked counterexample |
| 4 | Modify-flight rules | any modify task | basic-economy-flights-immutable, no origin/dest/trip change, cabin-flown rule, passenger-count-fixed, full-flights-list | DECISION/KNOWLEDGE | policy decision checklist |
| 5 | Compensation | any complaint task | wrong eligibility / wrong amount / proactive offer | DECISION/KNOWLEDGE | policy decision chain with amounts |
| 6 | Confirm-before-write + one-call-at-a-time | all write tasks | weak model skips confirmation or batches calls | BEHAVIORAL | unmissable golden-rule checklist + worked example |
| 7 | Error recovery | any task hitting a tool error | opaque errors strand the agent (seat/availability/payment) | KNOWLEDGE | enriched return/error text with next step |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | NEW compute tool (lever 4) | `tools.py::calculate_baggage_allowance` | Deterministically returns free allowance from membership×cabin×pax + fee + how to set nonfree. Can't be "forgotten" like a prose table; fixes the baggage-math class for every booking/baggage task. | Yes — additive READ tool; task 8 wants 0 bags, result unchanged |
| 1 | worked example + param docs | `policy.md` (Book), `tools.py::book_reservation` params | One concrete baggage+payment calc; literal per-param docs with the nonfree formula. | Yes — docs/text only |
| 2 | enriched errors (lever 8) | `tools.py::book_reservation` | payment-not-on-profile → lists available methods; low balance → shows balance vs requested; amount mismatch → states the exact total formula & target. Steers recovery next turn. | Yes — error paths only; success path identical |
| 2 | procedure | `policy.md` (Book payment steps 6–7) | Ordered rule: methods on profile, amounts sum to price, method-count limits. | Yes — text only |
| 3 | decision checklist + counterexample | `policy.md` (Cancel) | Ask reason → flown?→transfer; else require ≥1 of the 4 conditions; worked NON-eligible example. | Yes — text; no code guard (reason not available to cancel API, a code guard would risk false refusals) |
| 4 | decision checklist | `policy.md` (Modify) | Basic-economy flights immutable, no route/trip change, cabin-flown rule, passenger-count fixed, full flights list. | Yes — text only |
| 5 | decision chain | `policy.md` (Compensation) | Explicit-ask gate, eligibility test, confirm facts, $100×pax / $50×pax amounts. | Yes — text only |
| 6 | golden-rules checklist + worked example | `policy.md` (operating guide) | Identify-first, confirm-before-write, one-call-at-a-time made unmissable with an example. | Yes — reinforces what task 8 already does |
| 7 | enriched errors | `tools.py::book_reservation` (seat/availability) | seat shortage → shows available count + options; unavailable → shows status + next step. | Yes — error paths only |

## Verify-the-fix (trace → behavior change)
- `calculate_baggage_allowance`: ran the base+offset table against all 9 membership×cabin combos → matches the policy table exactly (verified in-session). For task-8 inputs (regular/economy/2 pax) returns 2 free, user wants 0 → nonfree stays 0 (no change).
- book_reservation payment-not-on-profile error: task 8's diagnostic showed exactly this class ("not on the user's profile; available=[...]"); the new message now emits that available list + next step, aiding recovery. Task 8 succeeds and never triggers it.
- book_reservation seat error: task 8 DID hit "Not enough seats on flight HAT139"; new message adds the available count + alternatives (what the agent had to reconstruct by hand), strictly more helpful, same control flow.
- Policy checklists: confirmed each restates an EXISTING policy rule (no invented rule, no broadened permission); all original rule lines are retained verbatim below the operating guide (no constraint dropped).

## Process & features used
- Serial (single candidate, one capability, one small trace set) — parallel subagents/worktrees unnecessary for a 1-trace seed; fan-out buys nothing here.
- Prior iterations: none (seed run; LEDGER/JOURNAL/RUNMAP empty, rejected.jsonl empty).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- All original policy constraints are kept verbatim; only additive structure/examples were layered on.
- Tool edits are additive or error-path-only — no existing success path or signature-breaking change (new tool adds params only on itself).
- Code enforces the baggage math via a HELPER the agent calls (not a silent server-side override of nonfree), avoiding payment-mismatch regressions.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- Silent server-side correction of nonfree_baggages inside book_reservation: would decouple from the agent's quoted payment amount and could create NEW payment-mismatch rejections on otherwise-valid bookings. Kept as a compute helper instead.
- In-code cancellation/modify eligibility guards: the cancel API has no `reason` argument and modify eligibility needs flown-status/route semantics; a deterministic guard risks false refusals that strand valid tasks. Enforced via sharp policy checklists instead (prompt surface).
- Removing any primitive: no tool is redundant yet; toolset is 15 (< 20 guideline).
